free_tier.stated: NO QUOTA ANYWHERE IN THE SERVER. There is no quota code, no quota column in the DB migrations, and no quota endpoint. Because the feature does not exist. A contributor filed Feature Request #334 '(Feature Request) Disable uploads when less than X GB of storage is available', still Open 5 months later, precisely because an admin cannot cap anything. Storage is whatever the instance's disks hold: OSM-FR alone reports 22.7M pictures = 48.5 TB of originals + 22.5 TB of derivates.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

egress.terms: Unmetered and CDN-friendly: no auth on any GET, plain nginx serving, Accept-Ranges honored. Verified 206 Partial Content with Content-Range: bytes 0-1023/3336348 on a live HD original.

interface_detail: REST + OGC API Features + STAC 1.0 + STAC item-search. POST /api/upload_sets → POST /api/upload_sets/{id}/files → POST /api/upload_sets/{id}/complete. Bearer token from POST /api/auth/tokens/generate.
tooling: panoramax_cli (v1.4.1, Windows/Linux binaries + Python lib) with `upload`, `download`, `transfer`, `migration` subcommands; Docker `panoramax/api`; JOSM/iD plugins; the CLI can also *transfer* sequences between instances, so one file can be replicated across the whole federation.
chaining: Upload once → replicate to N instances with `panoramax_cli transfer` → each instance serves its own /images/<2/2/2/2>/<uuid>.jpg path → front the whole federation with Cloudflare. Since every picture is addressed by a stable UUID and every asset URL is in the STAC item's `assets.hd.href`, a proxy can rewrite to whichever instance is alive.
limits_note: Two-object model, must be JP(E)G (HEIC unsupported. Issue #186), EXIF GPS + timestamp mandatory, images deduplicated by distance/rotation within an upload set. Approx 18 MB per 96 MP photo. Nothing enforces a byte ceiling.

identity_cost.detail: Email. But indirectly. `/api/configuration` on OSM-FR literally returns `"registration_is_open": true` and `/api/auth/login` 302s to openstreetmap.org/oauth2/authorize; the OSM signup form (/user/new) accepts `user[email]` + `user[display_name]` + password, no affiliation, no .edu, no review, email-confirm only. IGN instance uses its own Keycloak (`panoramax.ign.fr/oauth/realms/geovisio`). Eithe….

reliability_note: Volunteer hardware with ZFS RAIDZ2 + daily remote snapshots; no SLA and no capacity guard, so an instance can silently fill and start 500ing on upload. That is the whole reason #334 exists.
confidence_note: mechanically converted from the seed corpus; no page was read for this record in the storage-dossier pass. One page read moves it to documented.

evidence.proved: live STAC catalog, 2.15.1, links to /api/upload_sets, /api/users/, CC-BY-SA-4.0
same URL with Range: bytes=0-1023 — HTTP/1.1 206 Partial Content, Content-Range: bytes 0-1023/3336348
open feature request to *add* a storage floor; proves no quota mechanism exists
100M pictures across 10 instances, 1M 72MP pictures ≈ 9 TB originals, 360° tiling doubles it
FS_PERMANENT_URL = 'definitive storage of original, high-definition ... pictures'; derivates are only thumb/sd/tiles, i.e. the hd asset IS the original
